intro: To use temporary chat in ChatGPT on Mac, open the desktop app, click the model name at the top of the window, and turn on the Temporary Chat toggle. You can also start it from the File menu, and the steps below cover both routes.
tldr: Click the model name at the top of the ChatGPT window, then turn on the Temporary Chat toggle.
The File menu in the Mac app also offers Temporary Chat. Read the exact label on your version.
The ChatGPT Mac app needs macOS 14 and an Apple silicon chip such as M1, M2, or M3.
Some third-party guides list Shift Command N. OpenAI's own help pages could not be checked, so test it first.

blocks.text: What temporary chat is and when to use it

Temporary Chat is a mode in the ChatGPT Mac app. You turn it on, then ask your questions the way you normally would. It suits quick questions you would rather not keep in your regular list of chats. It is not a promise of privacy. The sources checked for this page do not spell out what OpenAI stores, so treat that as an open question, not a guarantee.

A good first use is a one-off task. Say you need a shorter version of a message that mentions a coworker and a project. Open a temporary chat, paste the draft, ask for a tighter version, and copy the result. You do not have to file that draft under a project or pin it later.

Temporary Chat is a poor fit for work you plan to return to. If you need the answer next week, a normal chat is easier to find. You can copy the key points into a note as well. Use the mode for questions you would close the window on anyway.
Temporary chat requirements for Mac

The ChatGPT Mac app needs macOS 14 and an Apple silicon chip. The Mac Install Guide lists M1, M2, and M3 as the chips the app needs. An Intel Mac does not meet that requirement, so these steps will not match what you see there. To check your chip, open the Apple menu, then About This Mac.

Open the desktop app before you try any of this. The web version may show different controls, so the title bar and File menu steps here do not carry over to it. Sign in if the app asks you to. Update the app first if the menus look different from the ones described here.
Turn on temporary chat from the title bar

This is the route most people use. Look at the top of the ChatGPT window, where the model name sits. Click it and a menu opens. Find the Temporary Chat toggle in that menu and switch it on. The chat you work in after that is a temporary one.

Check the toggle state before you type. If you already have a conversation open, the safest move is to start a new chat with the toggle on. Do not paste sensitive text into a chat you opened before you turned the mode on. Check first, then type.
Start temporary chat from the File menu

The File menu gives you the same mode from the menu bar. Click the ChatGPT window so the app is active. Then click File at the top of the screen. Scan the items for one that says Temporary, and choose it. Labels can change between app versions, so read the menu you see rather than trusting a guide's exact wording.

The menu bar belongs to whichever app is active. If you are in Finder or Safari, File shows that app's items, not ChatGPT's. Click the ChatGPT window first, then open File. This trips people up often, so check the window title before you go looking for the item.

blocks.text: Check that temporary chat is on

items: Open the model menu from the title bar and read the Temporary Chat toggle.
Send a short test prompt in the new chat and read the reply.
After the session, look at your sidebar to see whether the chat appears there.
Write down the label you saw, so the next visit takes less time.

blocks.text: The sidebar check tells you the most, but it is a test, not a promise. The sources here do not say how temporary chats appear in history. Run the check once, note what your app shows, and use that as your baseline for later sessions.
Switch back to a normal chat

To go back to a normal chat, start a new chat with the toggle off. Check the model menu before you type. If the toggle is still on, switch it off or start over. Keep one habit: read the mode before each sensitive question, not only the first one of the day.

Temporary Chat is not a clean-up tool for old conversations. The sources here do not say it touches past chats at all, so do not count on it for that. To remove chats you already have, follow the steps on the delete page linked below. That is a separate task.
What temporary chat does not promise

This page could not reach OpenAI's help pages, so retention, model training, sync across devices, and plan limits are not verified here. Treat any claim you read in a third-party guide with care, this one included. Check OpenAI's help center for the current wording before you make a decision that depends on it.

Data Controls is a separate setting. The steps for chat history live there, and the linked guide covers them along with their limits. Do not mix the two up. The sources checked here do not show that turning on Temporary Chat changes Data Controls.

Temporary Chat is not a reason to share sensitive data. Do not paste passwords, card numbers, or private medical details into any chat because you think a mode hides them. The mode does not change what you send. Use the same caution you would use with any cloud tool.
Worked examples you can try today

Say you have a lease clause you do not understand. Open a temporary chat, paste the clause, and ask for a plain-language version. Then ask what to check before you sign. Read the answer closely, and take the clause to a lawyer if the stakes are high. The chat is a reading aid, not a legal opinion.

Say you want gift ideas for a friend who likes running. Start a temporary chat, list the friend's interests in plain words, and ask for a short list of ideas. Keep the list in the chat if you like it, or copy the best options into a note before you close the window.

Say you need a quick check on the tax on a receipt. Type the figures in plain words in a temporary chat, and ask the app to show its working. Check that working yourself before you rely on the answer. Math in chat tools can be wrong, so the working matters more than the final line.

A few mistakes show up often. The first is forgetting the toggle is on, which leaves you thinking a normal chat is temporary. The second is assuming a chat you opened before turning the mode on is covered. The third is treating a one-off chat as a safe place for sensitive data.
Where to go next

If you want to clear out older chats, read [How to delete a chat in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/delete-a-chat-in-chatgpt). For the chats you want to keep handy, [How to pin a chat in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/pin-a-chat-in-chatgpt) covers the sidebar. For the chat history setting, see [How to turn off chat history in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/turn-off-chat-history-in-chatgpt).
What this guide checked and what it did not

The steps come from two third-party guides, iGeeksBlog and the Mac Install Guide. OpenAI's own help pages could not be reached when checked, so the menu labels here are the ones those guides describe. Your version may label things differently. Compare the title bar and File menu with what you see before you rely on them.

No keyboard shortcut is verified for Temporary Chat. Some third-party sites list ⇧⌘N for a new chat. Test it yourself and watch the File menu for a shortcut shown next to the item. If the shortcut does not match, use the menu steps instead.

faq.question: Is temporary chat the same as a private browsing window?
faq.answer: I could not confirm that. Temporary Chat is a setting inside the ChatGPT Mac app, and private browsing is a browser feature. They work at different levels, so do not assume they behave the same way.

faq.question: Does temporary chat need a paid plan?
faq.answer: The sources checked for this page do not say. Check OpenAI's pricing page for the plan rules before you rely on the feature for work.

faq.question: Can I turn on temporary chat with a keyboard shortcut?
faq.answer: I could not verify one. Some third-party guides list Shift Command N, so test it yourself and check the File menu for a shortcut shown next to the item.

faq.question: Will it work on an Intel Mac?
faq.answer: The Mac app needs macOS 14 and an Apple silicon chip such as M1, M2, or M3. An Intel Mac does not meet that requirement, so check OpenAI's help center for what an Intel Mac can use.

faq.question: Does temporary chat delete the chats I already have?
faq.answer: The sources here do not say that it does. To remove chats you already have, follow the delete steps for each chat or the steps for clearing your history.

faq.question: Can I use temporary chat in the browser version too?
faq.answer: This guide covers only the Mac app. The web version may use different controls, so check OpenAI's help center before you follow these steps there.

faq.question: Does temporary chat change my Data Controls?
faq.answer: The sources checked here do not show a link between the two. Read the Data Controls guide for those settings, and do not assume one changes the other.

steps.name: Open the ChatGPT desktop app
steps.text: Open ChatGPT from Applications or from the Dock. Sign in if the app asks you to. These steps cover the Mac app only, since the web version may show different controls.

steps.name: Look at the top of the window
steps.text: The model name sits in the title bar at the top of the ChatGPT window. It shows which model you are using. Click it to open the menu for the window.

steps.name: Turn on the Temporary Chat toggle
steps.text: In the menu that opens, find the Temporary Chat toggle and switch it on. Leave it on before you type your first message.
steps.tip: Read the toggle again if you switch models, so you know the mode you are in.

steps.name: Or start from the File menu
steps.text: Click the ChatGPT window so the app is active. Then click File in the menu bar at the top of the screen. Look for the item that says Temporary and choose it.
steps.tip: Labels can change between versions. Read the menu you see, not the label in this guide.

steps.name: Confirm you are in a temporary chat
steps.text: Before you type anything sensitive, open the model menu again and confirm the toggle is on. Then send a short test prompt and read the reply.
steps.tip: Check the toggle after every new chat, not only the first one.

steps.name: Ask your question and check the sidebar
steps.text: Type your question in the chat box and send it. When you finish, look at the sidebar to see whether the chat appears there, and note what you see.
steps.tip: Run this check once so you know how your app behaves.

troubleshooting.problem: I can't find the Temporary Chat toggle.
troubleshooting.fix: Click the model name in the title bar again, and confirm you are in the ChatGPT desktop app. If it still does not show, use the File menu route. Then update ChatGPT and check again.

troubleshooting.problem: The app won't run on my Mac.
troubleshooting.fix: The Mac app needs macOS 14 and an Apple silicon chip such as M1, M2, or M3. Check the Apple menu, then About This Mac, before you reinstall anything.

troubleshooting.problem: My temporary chat still shows in the sidebar.
troubleshooting.fix: Do not assume it is gone or hidden. The sources here do not say how temporary chats appear in history. Check OpenAI's help center for the current behavior.

troubleshooting.problem: I can't tell which mode I am in.
troubleshooting.fix: Open the model menu and read the toggle state. If you cannot tell, start a new chat, then check the toggle again before you type anything.
No shortcut is verified for Temporary Chat. Use the title bar or File menu route. If the File menu shows a shortcut next to the item, use that one.
